# M11 follow-up register and additional-source decision

The nine required sources have been assessed in order. The provider-timeout
and GWAS mechanisms are [released](m11-release-verification.json). Robin's
owner-authorized outcome refinement is [released](robin/m11-ui-release-verification.json),
but its campaign-owned live observation remains open. Novelty search and a
replacement for the retired free route remain open. On 26 September the owner
instructed us to skip the blocked route qualification and continue with independent
campaign work. That skips requests, not the acceptance evidence: the route-dependent
items below remain unverified, and no scientific candidate is rejected by deferral.
`PLAN.md` owns completion.

Current provider-source research identifies [Cloudflare Workers AI Free](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/) as a distinct conditional route: its Free plan stops at 10,000 Neurons/day rather than billing overage, and its [data-use policy](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/data-usage/) says customer content is not used for model training or service improvement. Its [documented JSON Mode model list](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/features/json-mode/) and long-context model options do not yet establish one route that satisfies every project interface; no Cloudflare account or credential is confirmed, and no project call was made. [Cerebras terms](https://www.cerebras.ai/terms-of-service) prohibit benchmarking or competitive analysis of its service, so its time-limited trial is not selected for this campaign. [GitHub Models](https://docs.github.com/en/github-models) was retired on 30 July 2026, including its inference API, so the existing GitHub login cannot supply this route. These are research dispositions, not qualifications or authorizations to change defaults.

On 26 September Chrome showed a saved Cloudflare Google sign-in profile, but the dashboard was still at `/login`. The button states that continuing agrees to Cloudflare's terms and privacy policy; no sign-in, agreement acceptance, account-plan readback or key creation occurred. The [Llama 3.3 70B](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast/) route has documented tools, streaming and JSON Mode but only a 24,000-token context, while [GPT-OSS 120B](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/gpt-oss-120b/) has a 128,000-token context and tools but is absent from the [JSON Mode support list](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/features/json-mode/). These are static capability facts, not a compatible single-route or scientific-quality result. User confirmation is required before the sign-in action that accepts terms; account Free status and actual product fit remain unknown.

[Hugging Face Inference Providers](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/en/pricing) gives a Free account $0.10 in monthly credits, then requires purchased credits for further use. Those credits offset metered provider prices rather than establishing an exact-zero route under this campaign's admission rule; this host also has no Hugging Face token or CLI login. Its [routing privacy policy](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/security) delegates provider-specific handling to each provider. No account, paid credits, model call or product integration was attempted.

## Additional repository selection

**Selected: zero.** Each unresolved mechanism has a pinned required-source
comparison and an exact local or official-service boundary to test. No proposed
additional repository supplies a distinct missing mechanism or a provider-backed
replay guarantee that these investigations require. Another general Co-Scientist
clone would duplicate the nine required implementation comparisons; another
broad tool catalog would not establish the GWAS service's live behavior or terms.
Those categories are excluded for this campaign, not assessed as defective
software. If a concrete gap appears during the remaining acceptance work, record
its evidence in `PLAN.md` before reconsidering this decision; the three-source
ceiling and the existing turn limit remain.
